// Only the SQL inside Go raw strings is scanned: Go identifiers and comments that
// mention total_35 or ON CONFLICT (account_id, week_of) are not hits, and neither is a
// `--` comment inside the query.

package gen

// Reads total, never total_35.
const listScoredMocks = `-- name: ListScoredMocks :many
SELECT id, total, max_total -- not total_35
FROM assessment.mock_session
WHERE account_id = $1 AND path_slug = $2
`

type ListScoredMocksRow struct {
	Total35Legacy pgtype.Int4 // total_35
}

const upsert = `-- name: Upsert :one
INSERT INTO review.weak_area_snapshot (account_id, week_of, path_slug) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
ON CONFLICT (account_id, path_slug, week_of) DO NOTHING
`
